domain: All signed i64 values interpreted as unsigned bitpatterns U(x)=x if x>=0 else x+2^64

cases.identity: Adding 2^64 to both preserves order; U(a)<U(b) iff a<b

nativeCompare: CMP establishes carry clear exactly when unsigned minuend<subtrahend; CSET LO returns exact 0 or 1
negativeImmediate: For 1<=k<=4095, CMN x,k carry set iff U(x)+k>=2^64 iff U(x)>=2^64-k=U(-k); CSET LO therefore equals CMP x,U(-k). Zero uses CMP. Other constants load a register.
observableSemantics: Exact helper has no FUEL/runtime/cap/alloc/call ops. Pure scalar result does not alter ctx, fuel, allocation or traps; caller frame and original fuel remain. No equivalence of arbitrary mathematical programs or result cache is claimed.
